title: Implement V2 six-zone desktop shell
goal: Implement the approved six-zone desktop navigation, plan overview, plan and assignment forms, acceptance surfaces, resource maintenance, dialogs, 420px drawer and desktop-only styles while retaining V1 DOM contracts
acceptance_criteria: Preserve every frozen V1 ID and add every frozen V2 ID exactly once
Six top-level tabs and active content fit 1280x720 and 1366x768 without page horizontal overflow
All seven dialogs, 420px drawer, empty states, status colors, focus targets and accessibility semantics match ARC-COMP-004
No mobile breakpoint or touch-only navigation is introduced

release_controls.rollback_plan: revert the independent index.html and styles.css delivery commit
release_controls.observation_metrics: DOM ID uniqueness, V1 selector preservation, two desktop viewport metrics, browser screenshots, reviewer evidence
release_controls.stop_conditions: DOM contract drift, V1 selector removal, page horizontal overflow, mobile scope expansion, failing validation, or unresolved reviewer finding
